description: Spring Framework can create and connect objects for a Java program. Its container looks after these shared objects, called beans. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.
versionNote: Examples use Spring Framework 6.1, Java 17 or later, and JBang.
whatYouWillLearn: Create a managed value with Spring Framework
Connect two objects with Spring Framework
Create a bean when needed with Spring Framework
Run cleanup when closing with Spring Framework
learningObjectives: Create a managed value with Spring Framework
Share one bean instance with Spring Framework
Run a setup method with Spring Framework
